question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is **"Monologe."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is **'Monologue.'** • The incorrect spelling in option 2 has an extra **'e' **added at the end. • The correct pronunciation is **'mon-uh-log'**, with stress on the second syllable. • **"Monologue" **means a long speech by one person, for example in a play. (अकेले व्यक्ति का लंबा भाषण (जैसे नाटक में), एकालाप; स्‍वगत भाषण) • **Example**: *He subjected me to a **monologue**__ on his last stay in hospital.* • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1: 'Mischievous' **means causing or showing a fondness for causing trouble in a playful way. ((प्रायः बच्‍चों के लिए प्रयुक्त) शरारती, नटखट) • **Option 3: 'Maintenance'** means the process of maintaining or preserving something. (रख-रखाव) • **Option 4: 'Millionaire'** means a person whose wealth amounts to at least a million dollars. (लखपति, करोड़पति; बहुत धनी व्‍यक्ति) 33:Te36, The correct answer is **"Insensitive."**
